newsitem.title: USA: Cisco Systems cuts list price on AS5200.
newsitem.headline: Cisco Systems cuts list price on AS5200.

text.p: Cisco Systems Inc said Tuesday it has reduced the list price on its AS5200 universal access server by 25 percent.
The company said it also plans to deliver free 56K technology upgrades on all new purchases of the AS5200 made after February 1.
It said the new U.S. list price starts at $28,100 with 48 integrated managed modems and Cisco IOS software for IP routing.
Existing AS5200 customers will have the chance to participate in the 56K upgrade program at a nominal charge, it said, adding that first customer shipments are expected in the middle of 1997.
Cisco is leading maker of networking products for the Internet.
